retrievalProfile.description: A centered, shirtless male portrait with dramatic low-key lighting and a dark vignette background, featuring small sans-serif typography at the top edge.
excludeWhen: busy or outdoor backgrounds are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A shirtless male subject with an athletic build and an afro hairstyle is centered against a dark, moody background. The lighting is directional, creating deep shadows and highlighting muscle definition. A subtle blue-to-black gradient vignette frames the lower left corner, while the top of the frame features small, white, centered sans-serif text.
coreVisualRelationships: High contrast between skin tones and dark background
Typography positioned at the extreme top margin
Symmetrical pose with hands on hips
coreInvariants: Low-key studio lighting with high contrast
Dark, non-descript background with subtle color vignette

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical frame from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and chest muscles serve as the primary focal points due to lighting highlights.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the face, moves down the torso to the hands on hips, then up to the centered text at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant dark negative space surrounds the subject, particularly at the top and sides.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and dark browns in the background and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm, golden-brown skin tones highlighted by studio lights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Subtle cool blue-grey gradient in the lower left background.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low value overall with high local contrast on the subject; saturation is naturalistic but warm.
paletteRestrictions: Limit background to dark neutrals and subtle gradients

composition.relationshipToImage: Floating in negative space above the subject's head

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for minimalist impact.

candidateDirections.reason: Geometric clarity matches the era's clean aesthetic.
Provides a similar weight and humanist-geometric balance.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a shirtless man with an athletic build and afro, centered against a dark background with low-key lighting and a subtle blue vignette in the bottom left corner.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the artist name in a small, bold, white geometric sans-serif font, centered at the very top of the frame with wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting low-key with high contrast on the torso?
Is the text small and positioned at the top edge?
Is the background dark and vignetted?

adjustableVariables: Subject's pose (hands on hips vs. arms down)
mustRedesign: Avoid using specific artist names or logos
Ensure the lighting highlights muscle definition without being overexposed
postGenerationChecks: Confirm no clothing is visible above the waist
